title: Sigurnosne kontrole, BC i DR
summary: Fizičke, IAA, sistemske, storage i komunikacijske kontrole i audit mehanizmi u cloudu; BC/DR strategija, BIA i metrike RTO, RPO, RSL i MTD, cloud DR obrasci te izrada i testiranje plana.
summary_en: Physical, IAA, system, storage, and communication controls and audit mechanisms in the cloud; BC/DR strategy, BIA and the RTO, RPO, RSL, and MTD metrics, cloud DR patterns, and plan creation and testing.
